mechanism_evidence.source_event: NEURO_CAV1_PCREB_H3K9AC (CaV1 L-type Ca2+ influx -> pCREB -> NeuroD1/Ngn1 promoter H3K9ac)
mechanism_evidence.target_event: NEURO_DG_NEUROGENESIS (Adult hippocampal DG BrdU+/DCX+ & BrdU+/NeuN+ neurogenesis)
mechanism_evidence.supporting_quote: Interestingly, these epigenetic effects were prevented by nifedipine, thus confirming a pivotal role of Cav1 channel
mechanism_evidence.intervention_or_joint_measurement: 5 µM nifedipine CaV1 blockade in vitro (E1.1); separate in vivo DG stereology cohort (E1.2/E1.3)
mechanism_evidence.tissue_scope: Hippocampal neural stem cells (dish) & dentate gyrus (in vivo)
mechanism_evidence.life_stage_scope: Adult male mouse (4-5 weeks at start) & cultured adult NSCs
mechanism_evidence.context_limitations: Nifedipine blockade was performed in cultured NSCs (E1.1), whereas BrdU+/DCX+ and BrdU+/NeuN+ counts (E1.2/E1.3) were measured in separate in vivo cohorts without in vivo conditional CaV1 knockout.

mechanism_evidence.source_event: NEURO_HIPP_NMDAR_GLUN2 (Hippocampal GluN2A & GluN2B NMDAR subunit protein expression, E6.1)
mechanism_evidence.target_event: NEURO_HIPP_CA1_LTP_EXCITABILITY (Hippocampal CA1 Schaffer-collateral LTP induction efficacy, E5.1/E5.2)
mechanism_evidence.supporting_citation: Li et al., 2014 (Environ Res) & Varró et al., 2009 (Bioelectromagnetics)
mechanism_evidence.supporting_quote: Perfusion of Mg2+-free solution results in the removal of the Mg2+ from the NMDA-type glutamate receptor... whole-body exposure enhanced the efficacy of LTP induction, especially in the WhB 15 group
mechanism_evidence.intervention_or_joint_measurement: Cross-study hypothesis only: Li 2014 measured GluN2A/2B protein without electrophysiology; Varró 2009 measured CA1 LTP without GluN2 blot
mechanism_evidence.species_scope: Rat (adult male Sprague-Dawley in E6; adult male Wistar in E5)
mechanism_evidence.tissue_scope: Hippocampus (whole hippocampal extract in E6 vs. CA1 slice in E5)
mechanism_evidence.life_stage_scope: Adult male rat (14-day exposure in E6 vs. 15-day exposure in E5)
mechanism_evidence.context_limitations: Total GluN2A/2B protein elevation in E6 does not prove synaptic surface insertion or conductances in E5; E5 raw text also has µT/mT OCR prefix ambiguity. Supports a combined blot+LTP experiment in the same rat cohort.

mechanism_evidence.target_event: NEURO_CALYX_CAV2_CHANNEL (Auditory brainstem calyx of Held presynaptic CaV2.1/CaV2.3 protein, E2.1/E2.2)
mechanism_evidence.supporting_citation: Leone et al., 2014 & Sun et al., 2016
mechanism_evidence.supporting_quote: Western blots showed that all three subtypes of calcium channels are expressed at higher levels in the ELF-EMF exposure group
mechanism_evidence.intervention_or_joint_measurement: Separate studies, cell types, and brain regions (adult hippocampal NSCs vs. neonatal P8-P10 auditory brainstem calyx)
mechanism_evidence.tissue_scope: Hippocampal NSCs vs. Auditory brainstem calyx of Held (NON-EQUIVALENT brain regions)
mechanism_evidence.context_limitations: CaV1 (L-type) in hippocampal stem cells and CaV2.1/2.3 (P/Q & R-type) in neonatal auditory brainstem terminals belong to the voltage-gated Ca2+ channel superfamily under 50 Hz 1 mT, but MUST NOT be stitched into a single hippocampal memory pathway.

mechanism_evidence.source_event: NEURO_DG_NEUROGENESIS / NEURO_HIPP_NEURON_SYNAPSE_SURVIVAL (Mouse DG neurogenesis E1.2/1.3 & CA3 survival E3.2)
mechanism_evidence.supporting_quote: number of NeuN-positive cells in the CA3 area deceased in 3xTg-SE... whole-body exposure enhanced the efficacy of LTP induction
mechanism_evidence.intervention_or_joint_measurement: No single study measured DG neurogenesis, CA3 survival, and CA1 LTP simultaneously
mechanism_evidence.life_stage_scope: Adult rodent (healthy C57BL/6, 3xTg-AD mouse, healthy Wistar rat)
mechanism_evidence.context_limitations: Co-location within the hippocampal DG-CA3-CA1 circuit provides anatomical context for meso-scale comparison under 50 Hz exposure, NOT proof that DG neurogenesis in E1 caused CA1 LTP in E5.

mechanism_evidence.source_event: NEURO_MWM_SPATIAL_MEMORY (Morris water maze spatial reference learning, E1.4/E3.3/E6.2/E6.3)
mechanism_evidence.supporting_quote: ELFEFs showed a significant reduction in the latency to find... ELFEF-exposed mice showed a higher discrimination ability
mechanism_evidence.intervention_or_joint_measurement: E1 measured both MWM and NOR in the same study; E4 measured Y-maze under restraint/implant
mechanism_evidence.context_limitations: Morris water maze (multi-day spatial reference memory), Y-maze (acute trial working memory under restraint/implant), and NOR (recognition memory) tax distinct cognitive sub-processes and stress levels; opposite directions (E1.4/E1.5 improved vs. E4.2 impaired) reflect protocol/task differences, not a simple dose law.

mechanism_evidence.source_event: CELL_ROS_OXIDATIVE_STRESS (1800 MHz waveguide germ-cell mitochondrial superoxide MitoSOX, F1.1)
mechanism_evidence.target_event: DNA_SSB_8OHDG_ALKALINE_COMET / REPRO_AMPK_MTOR_AUTOPHAGY (8-OHdG & alkaline comet F1.2/F1.3/F2.1; p-AMPK/mTOR autophagy F2.3)
mechanism_evidence.supporting_citation: Houston et al., 2018 (Front Public Health) & Li et al., 2018 (Cell Physiol Biochem)
mechanism_evidence.supporting_quote: The results showed that the phosphorylation levels of AMPK significantly increased and p-mTOR significantly decreased after RF-EMFs exposure
mechanism_evidence.intervention_or_joint_measurement: Houston 2018 compared GC-1/GC-2 vs. mature sperm at 0.15 W/kg (2-6 h CW); Li 2018 tested melatonin & AMPKalpha2 manipulation in GC-2 at 4.0 W/kg (24 h GSM-Talk)
mechanism_evidence.species_scope: Mouse (GC-1/GC-2 cell lines & isolated cauda spermatozoa)
mechanism_evidence.tissue_scope: In vitro male germ-cell lines and isolated mature spermatozoa
mechanism_evidence.life_stage_scope: Pre-meiotic/meiotic precursor lines vs. post-meiotic spermatozoa
mechanism_evidence.context_limitations: F1 used 1800 MHz CW at 0.15 W/kg for 2-6 h, whereas F2 used 1800 MHz GSM-Talk at 4.0 W/kg for 24 h (5m on/10m off). Li 2018's AMPK/autophagy findings support an intracellular mechanism within GC-2 at 4.0 W/kg, and provide a testable hypothesis—not direct proof—for why GC-1/GC-2 in F1 did not accumulate 8-OHdG at 0.15 W/kg.

mechanism_evidence.supporting_quote: The alkaline comet assay was performed to detect the DNA single- and double-strand breaks as well as alkali labile sites, and the neutral comet assay was carried out to detect DNA double-strand breaks
mechanism_evidence.intervention_or_joint_measurement: Same 4.0 W/kg 24 h GC-2 cell batch assayed by both alkaline comet, neutral comet, and gamma-H2AX blot
mechanism_evidence.context_limitations: Positive alkaline comet with negative neutral comet/gamma-H2AX demonstrates lesion-spectrum/assay-channel specificity under that protocol; it does not prove absolute absence of any DSB or universal reversibility.

mechanism_evidence.target_event: REPRO_SPERM_COUNT_AND_MORPHOLOGY (Cauda epididymal / ejaculated sperm concentration & count, F5.1a/F4.1/F7.2/R6.5/R6.6)
mechanism_evidence.supporting_citation: Imai et al., 2011 (Syst Biol Reprod Med)
mechanism_evidence.supporting_quote: No significant differences were observed among these values except for the sperm count in the testes, which was significantly greater in the high level exposure group than with the sham exposure.
mechanism_evidence.intervention_or_joint_measurement: Imai 2011 Table 2 simultaneously measured testicular sperm count and epididymal sperm count in the same 24 rats/group
mechanism_evidence.context_limitations: Testicular homogenate count reflects intratesticular elongated spermatid/sperm retention or production, whereas cauda epididymal count reflects post-transit storage; divergence within F5 (testis up, epididymis unchanged) shows the two compartments are not interchangeable.

retained_relations_203.A_bio_scientific_basis:

• 源观察 [E7.2 (E7)]: 大鼠 (Rat, Rattus norvegicus) | SD大鼠胚胎原代海马神经元DIV7-14每日8 h长时暴露臂 (DIV7-14 8 h/day prolonged-exposure arm) | 原代海马神经元CCK-8相对细胞代谢活性 (8 h/d长时暴露臂) (Relative cell viability under prolonged daily exposure (8 h/day, DIV7-14)) -> 方向: 降低 / 缩短 / 减少 (decrease vs. concurrent sham); 统计: 原文报告统计学显著 (reported_significant, p < 0.05/0.01/0.001)。
• 目标观察 [E7.3 (E7)]: 大鼠 (Rat, Rattus norvegicus) | SD大鼠胚胎原代海马神经元DIV7-14 ROS荧光测定队列 (DIV7-14 DCFH-DA ROS assay arm) | 胞内活性氧相关DCFH-DA荧光强度(及Nox2蛋白表达) (Intracellular ROS-associated fluorescence (DCFH-DA)) -> 方向: 升高 / 增强 (increase vs. concurrent sham); 统计: 原文报告统计学显著 (reported_significant, p < 0.05/0.01/0.001)。

retained_relations_203.A_bio_scientific_basis:

• 源观察 [F1.2 (F1)]: 小鼠 (Mouse, Mus musculus) | 体外具备完整胞质DNA修复能力的GC-1与GC-2生精前体细胞系队列 (In vitro repair-competent GC-1/GC-2 precursor lines) | 生精前体细胞系(GC-1/GC-2)氧化性DNA碱基加合物8-OHdG生成水平 (Oxidative DNA base lesion 8-OHdG in precursor germ-cell lines) -> 方向: 未检出显著方向差异 (not_resolved / null direction); 统计: 原文报告统计学不显著 (reported_nonsignificant, p > 0.05 ≠ 零效应)。
• 目标观察 [F2.3 (F2)]: 小鼠 (Mouse, Mus musculus) | 体外小鼠GC-2spd(ts)精母细胞系4 W/kg暴露组[AMPK/mTOR免疫印迹通道] (GC-2 4 W/kg AMPK/mTOR blot channel) | 磷酸化AMPKα(Thr172)激活与磷酸化mTOR抑制水平 (Western blot, Figure 4A) (AMPK phosphorylation (phospho-AMPKalpha Thr172) & mTOR repression) -> 方向: 升高 / 增强 (increase vs. concurrent sham); 统计: 原文报告统计学显著 (reported_significant, p < 0.05/0.01/0.001)。

retained_relations_203.A_bio_scientific_basis:

• 源观察 [F1.3 (F1)]: 小鼠 (Mouse, Mus musculus) | 离体分离的小鼠附睾尾成熟精子悬浮液队列[与GC-1/2平行对比的修复缺陷阶段!] (In vitro isolated mature cauda spermatozoa cohort) | 成熟附睾尾精子氧化性碱基损伤(8-OHdG)与碱性彗星DNA碎片化水平 (Oxidative DNA base adduct (8-OHdG) & alkaline-comet fragmentation in mature spermatozoa) -> 方向: 升高 / 增强 (increase vs. concurrent sham); 统计: 原文报告统计学显著 (reported_significant, p < 0.05/0.01/0.001)。
• 目标观察 [F6.2 (F6)]: 大鼠 (Rat, Rattus norvegicus) | 成年Wistar雄鼠睾丸与附睾组织匀浆GSH测定队列[与F6.1同批大鼠] (Same rat cohort testis/epididymis GSH homogenate) | 睾丸与附睾组织胞内还原型谷胱甘肽(GSH)抗氧化含量 (Testicular & epididymal reduced glutathione (GSH) concentration) -> 方向: 降低 / 缩短 / 减少 (decrease vs. concurrent sham); 统计: 原文报告统计学显著 (reported_significant, p < 0.05/0.01/0.001)。

retained_relations_203.A_bio_scientific_basis:

• 源观察 [R6.3 (R6)]: 大鼠 (Rat, Rattus norvegicus) | Crl:CD(SD)大鼠60 kHz实验1批次[与R6.5精子计数下降为同一批次动物!] (60 kHz Experiment 1 batch, shared with R6.5) | 妊娠生育指数：怀孕雌鼠数 / 确认交配雌鼠数 (%, 60 kHz实验1, Table 4) (Fertility index: pregnant females / copulated females (%, 60 kHz Exp 1)) -> 方向: 降低 / 缩短 / 减少 (decrease vs. concurrent sham); 统计: 原文报告统计学不显著 (reported_nonsignificant, p > 0.05 ≠ 零效应)。
• 目标观察 [R6.6 (R6)]: 大鼠 (Rat, Rattus norvegicus) | Crl:CD(SD)雄鼠60 kHz实验2独立重复批次[验证实验1结果的批次可重复性] (60 kHz Experiment 2 male replicate cohort) | 单侧附睾尾匀浆精子总数 (10^6 / cauda epididymis, 60 kHz实验2, Table 8) (Sperm count per cauda epididymis (10^6, 60 kHz Exp 2)) -> 方向: 降低 / 缩短 / 减少 (decrease vs. concurrent sham); 统计: 原文报告统计学不显著 (reported_nonsignificant, p > 0.05 ≠ 零效应)。

retained_relations_203.A_phys_scientific_basis: 【物理比较状态: P1_WithinStudy_Same_Exposure_Arm_and_Preparation (同研究同一暴露臂与同一生物制备体系)】频率关系=same_exact_frequency (60 kHz (中频正弦交变磁场 / 60 kHz IF sinusoidal MF) vs. 60 kHz (中频正弦交变磁场 / 60 kHz IF sinusoidal MF)) | 波形关系=same_waveform_and_modulation | 剂量关系=same_nominal_exposure_arm | 时程关系=same_exposure_schedule | 批次关系=independent_replicate_batch_same_nominal_protocol。源内部剂量状态=external_quantity_reported_internal_E_unmodeled；目标内部剂量状态=external_quantity_reported_internal_E_unmodeled。
retained_relations_203.A_bio_scientific_basis:
【生物学同源/通路依据】同研究实验设计关联 (R6 Nishimura et al., 2012 (Regul Toxicol Pharmacol))：源观察 [R6.5: 单侧附睾尾匀浆精子总数 (10^6 / cauda epididymis, TOX-IVOS计算机辅助分析, Table 8) (Sperm count per cauda epididymis (10^6, 60 kHz Exp 1))] 与目标观察 [R6.6: 单侧附睾尾匀浆精子总数 (10^6 / cauda epididymis, 60 kHz实验2, Table 8) (Sperm count per cauda epididymis (10^6, 60 kHz Exp 2))] 出自同一篇原始研究。实验亚组关系：Crl:CD(SD)雄鼠60 kHz实验1批次(确认交配后3天内盲法剖检) (60 kHz Experiment 1 male necropsy cohort) vs. Crl:CD(SD)雄鼠60 kHz实验2独立重复批次[验证实验1结果的批次可重复性] (60 kHz Experiment 2 male replicate cohort)。
• 源观察 [R6.5 (R6)]: 大鼠 (Rat, Rattus norvegicus) | Crl:CD(SD)雄鼠60 kHz实验1批次(确认交配后3天内盲法剖检) (60 kHz Experiment 1 male necropsy cohort) | 单侧附睾尾匀浆精子总数 (10^6 / cauda epididymis, TOX-IVOS计算机辅助分析, Table 8) (Sperm count per cauda epididymis (10^6, 60 kHz Exp 1)) -> 方向: 降低 / 缩短 / 减少 (decrease vs. concurrent sham); 统计: 原文报告统计学显著 (reported_significant, p < 0.05/0.01/0.001)。
• 目标观察 [R6.6 (R6)]: 大鼠 (Rat, Rattus norvegicus) | Crl:CD(SD)雄鼠60 kHz实验2独立重复批次[验证实验1结果的批次可重复性] (60 kHz Experiment 2 male replicate cohort) | 单侧附睾尾匀浆精子总数 (10^6 / cauda epididymis, 60 kHz实验2, Table 8) (Sperm count per cauda epididymis (10^6, 60 kHz Exp 2)) -> 方向: 降低 / 缩短 / 减少 (decrease vs. concurrent sham); 统计: 原文报告统计学不显著 (reported_nonsignificant, p > 0.05 ≠ 零效应)。

retained_relations_203.unresolved_differences: 信号调制/波形或暴露腔体不同 (60 kHz 大型校准线圈全身暴露 (雄鼠交配前14 d + 交配期，22 h/d) vs. 60 kHz 大型校准线圈全身暴露 (雄鼠交配前14 d + 交配期，22 h/d，实验2重复批次)) ； 至少一方靶组织微区内部电场或局部吸收SAR未测量/不可辨识 (Internal tissue dose unidentifiable/missing) ； 实验受试亚组/制备层级或解剖亚区不同 (Crl:CD(SD)雄鼠60 kHz实验1批次(确认交配后3天内盲法剖检) (60 kHz Experiment 1 male necropsy cohort) vs. Crl:CD(SD)雄鼠60 kHz实验2独立重复批次[验证实验1结果的批次可重复性] (60 kHz Experiment 2 male replicate cohort)) ； 检测方法通道不同 (Homogenized cauda epididymis TOX-IVOS computer-assisted count (Table 8) vs. Homogenized cauda epididymis TOX-IVOS count (Table 8)) ； 暴露时长覆盖度(tau_exp)或暴露后观测滞后(tau_obs)不同
retained_relations_203.permitted_inferences: 允许 (Permitted)：在同一实验室对照基线下分析日暴露时长分叉(E7)、强度组别分叉(E8、F5)、发育阶段修复能力差异(F1)、彗星/印迹测定通道化学特异性(F2)、交变与静态场机制差异(E4)及批次可重复性(R6)。
retained_relations_203.prohibited_inferences: 禁止 (Prohibited)：禁止将某一通道或批次的统计不显著(p>0.05)解释为零效应或绝对安全；禁止将同一批精液的相关运动分级(如F8b.1与F8b.2)重复计为独立实验研究。
